thread:
Alex: Quick sync — proposed retention change: shrink raw SIEM export TTL in primary bucket from 400d -> 90d. Goal: reduce sensitive data blast radius + storage. Need a defensible, auditable preserve flow for investigations and legal holds.
Maria: Important: legal hold vs object retention mode. We should prefer S3 Object Lock (GOVERNANCE or COMPLIANCE) for preserves so objects can’t be deleted until hold expires. Legal needs input.
Jon: Our external SOC queries historical data; if we move to 90d we must provide a clear workflow for on-demand 1y snapshots they can query without leaking raw PII.
Sam: Proposal sketch:
- primary-raw bucket: 90d lifecycle, default server-side envelope encryption with our CMK
- forensics-archive bucket: copies of snapshot objects with Object Lock in GOVERNANCE mode, 365d retention, HSM-backed CMK wrap
- partner-view bucket: masked/aggregated exports for 365d, partner CMK + cross-account role
- legal-preserve: an immutable marker that flips copy into Object Lock + tags case_id
PrivacyBot: Scrub rules need to be explicit. Define field-level drop rules and hashing/anonymization policy for partner-view. Privacy review required before partner exports go live.
Alex: How to implement preserve flow operationally? My thoughts:
1) A preserve request is created in SEC-5201 (ticket) containing case id, approver, justification.
2) On approval, a controller copies objects to forensics-archive, writes tag x-case-id and sets object lock retention date.
3) KMS never auto-unwraps; instead, unwraps require a short-lived KMS grant tied to the ticket and approver identity.
Jon: We must make unwraps explicit and traceable. No long-lived keys that analysts can use ad-hoc.
Sam: Audit pattern: every unwrap sequence writes three trails:
- CloudTrail KMS entry for GrantCreate/Decrypt events
- S3 access logs + signed URL creation audit
- Internal security-log index entry with: ts, event_type, case_id, object_key, requester, approver, grant_id, reason, ticket_id
Example index line (string): {"ts":"2026-04-02T08:15:00Z","event":"object_unwrap","case_id":"CASE-2026-321","object":"forensics/CASE-2026-321-20260401.tar.gz","requester":"jon","approver":"LegalTeamLead","grant_id":"g-9f8e7d6c","ticket":"SEC-5201"}
Maria: Also consider encryption-in-transit restrictions. Deliver snapshot via timeboxed presigned URL served behind SSO-proxy that mints ephemeral credentials; include download checksum attestation in the audit log.
Alex: What about automation + policy enforcement? OPA admission/controller can reject lifecycle delete actions when object tag x-preserve exists. We should also have a periodic reconcile that flags drift (e.g., objects that should be preserved but were expired).
Sam: Testing matrix I propose:
- staging: create object with TTL=15s, ensure after expiry direct GET returns 403 from OPA/controller and S3 lifecycle has not removed yet in staging;
- approval path: create object, open SEC-5201 approval, controller copies to forensics-archive with Object Lock, generate KMS grant, perform download -> assert audit entries present in security-index and CloudTrail
- partner path: run scrub job and compare sample counts to ensure masking reduces PII fields by expected rate
security-automation: ticket SEC-5201 created: "Retention change + preserve/unwrap playbook" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-5201
Legal: We need exact legal-hold wording. Object Lock COMPLIANCE mode is strongest but requires org-level governance. Legal prefers COMPLIANCE for subpoenas.
Maria: Cost check: Finance needs projected delta for S3 + Glacier + KMS HSM wrap to sign off. Will add cost estimate column to the PR.
Alex: Implementation TODOs:
- PR with architecture diagram + controller code sketch + OPA snippets + sample IAM for ephemeral grants
- minor infra job: nightly snapshot job + scrub pipeline for partner-view
- canary plan: shift low-value indices to 90d for 2 weeks and validate search/IR workflows
- test harness: automated integration tests for deny/unlock flows
Jon: One more ask: ensure we have an explicit retention-expiry notification workflow to IR/legal before objects drop below 90d so they can request preserves.
oncall-bot: Scheduling #sec-retention-sync Wed 4pm PT — invites to Alex, Maria, Jon, Sam, Legal, PrivacyBot
Alex: I'll draft the PR and populate SEC-5201 with the approval template and minimal audit schema. Posting draft later today. :thumbsup:
